title: Needle entry on the patient
view: Right side of the head of a seated patient, seen from the right: head up, face to the right (anterior), occiput to the left. Painted as a photograph.
teachingPoint: Two punctures - just below the lobe and just above the ear - and four subcutaneous tracks from them, in front of the tragus and behind the ear over the mastoid, closing a ring round the base of the ear. The tracks stay off the auricle.
claims: Right ear from the side, face to the right. Auricle about 62 x 33 mm, tilted back about 15 degrees; mandibular ramus and angle below and in front of the lobe; hairline above and behind the ear (standard adult anatomy, not from the record).
Red dots: the puncture sites, just below the earlobe and just above the ear (record, steps 2 and 4).
Teal: four subcutaneous tracks - inferior site to in front of the tragus, inferior site to behind the ear over the mastoid, superior site forward and back to meet them (record, steps 2-5).
Three labels: Puncture sites, Tragus, Mastoid.
